## Uploading the dataset into R

<br>
```{r}
#Specifying box path
path_to_box <- file.path("~", "Box Sync")

# Raw data is in "CABBS Data Transfer"
path_to_raw <- file.path(path_to_box, "CABBS Data Transfer")

# Analytic data folder for cleaned dataset
path_to_analytic_data <- file.path(path_to_raw, "analytic_data")

#Importing dataset
cabbs <- read.csv(file.path(path_to_raw, 
                              "Data_CABBS_11062025_no PHI.csv"))
head(cabbs)

```


```{r, message=FALSE, include = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(haven)
library(epiDisplay)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
```

#Identifying the number of duplicate subjectcodes, if any

```{r}
duplicate_subjects <- cabbs[duplicated(cabbs$subjectcode), ]
print(duplicate_subjects)
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
#install.packages('janitor')
library(janitor)
cluster_groups <- cabbs %>% get_dupes(subjectcode)
```

#Identifying participants with multiple blood draws and making a filtered dataset to only keep collected blood draws for participants with multiple draws

```{r}
library(dplyr)

#Identifying if duplicates are present
multiple_id <- cabbs %>%
  count(subjectcode) %>%
  filter(n > 1) %>%
  pull(subjectcode)

#Splitting data set into duplicates and non-duplicates
duplicates <- cabbs %>%
  filter(subjectcode %in% multiple_id) %>%
  filter(BD_Status == "Collected") %>%
  group_by(subjectcode) %>%   #run this and below on full cabbs data set for sanity check
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

non_duplicates <- cabbs %>%
  filter(!(subjectcode %in% multiple_id))

#Combining the non-duplicates, with the duplicate free to get a full datastet again
filtered_data <- bind_rows(duplicates, non_duplicates)


#Sanity check to see if we have no more duplicates - total of 7379 unique subject codes
total_unique <- filtered_data %>%
  distinct(subjectcode) %>%
  count()
print(total_unique)

```


#Creating a new variable to assess distribution of every Race and Ethnicity combination

```{r} 
filtered_data <- filtered_data %>%
  mutate(RaceEthnicity_new = case_when(
    Race_AfricanAmerican == 1 ~ paste("African American /", Ethnicity),
    Race_Asian == 1 ~ paste("Asian /", Ethnicity),
    Race_Caucasian == 1 ~ paste("White /", Ethnicity),
    Race_NativeAmerican == 1 ~ paste("NativeAmerican /", Ethnicity),
    Race_PacificIslander == 1 ~ paste("PacificIslander /", Ethnicity),
    Race_Other == 1 ~ paste("Other /", Ethnicity),
    Race_DeclinedToState == 1 ~ paste("DeclinedToState /", Ethnicity),
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))

table(filtered_data$RaceEthnicity_new, useNA = "ifany")

```

#Creating the FINAL version of the race/ethnicity variable

```{r}
library(dplyr)

filtered_data <- filtered_data %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(RaceEthnicity_final = case_when(
    Ethnicity == "Latino" ~ 1, #Latino  
    
    Ethnicity %in% c("Not Latino", "Declined To State") &
      Race_DeclinedToState == 1 ~ NA,
    
    Ethnicity %in% c("Not Latino", "Declined To State") &
      Race_AfricanAmerican == 1 &
      sum(c_across(c(Race_Asian, Race_Caucasian, Race_NativeAmerican, Race_PacificIslander, Race_Other, Race_DeclinedToState)), na.rm = TRUE) == 0 ~ 2, #"Non-Latino African American"
    
    Ethnicity %in% c("Not Latino", "Declined To State") &
      Race_Asian == 1 &
      sum(c_across(c(Race_AfricanAmerican, Race_Caucasian, Race_NativeAmerican, Race_PacificIslander, Race_Other, Race_DeclinedToState)), na.rm = TRUE) == 0 ~ 3, #"Non-Latino Asian"
   
    Ethnicity %in% c("Not Latino", "Declined To State") &
      sum(c_across(c(Race_AfricanAmerican, Race_Asian, Race_Caucasian, Race_NativeAmerican, Race_PacificIslander, Race_Other)), na.rm = TRUE) > 1 ~ 4, #"Non-Latino Multiracial",
    
    Ethnicity %in% c("Not Latino", "Declined To State") &
      Race_NativeAmerican == 1 &
      sum(c_across(c(Race_AfricanAmerican, Race_Asian, Race_Caucasian, Race_PacificIslander, Race_Other, Race_DeclinedToState)), na.rm = TRUE) == 0 ~ 5, #"Non-Latino Native American"
    
   Ethnicity %in% c("Not Latino", "Declined To State") &
      Race_Other == 1 &
      sum(c_across(c(Race_AfricanAmerican, Race_Asian, Race_Caucasian, Race_NativeAmerican, Race_PacificIslander, Race_DeclinedToState)), na.rm = TRUE) == 0 ~ 6, #"Non-Latino Other"
  
    Ethnicity %in% c("Not Latino", "Declined To State") &
      Race_PacificIslander == 1 &
      sum(c_across(c(Race_AfricanAmerican, Race_Asian, Race_Caucasian, Race_NativeAmerican, Race_Other, Race_DeclinedToState)), na.rm = TRUE) == 0 ~ 7, #"Non-Latino Pacific Islander"
  
      Ethnicity %in% c("Not Latino", "Declined To State") &
      Race_Caucasian == 1 &
      sum(c_across(c(Race_AfricanAmerican, Race_Asian, Race_NativeAmerican, Race_PacificIslander, Race_Other, Race_DeclinedToState)), na.rm = TRUE) == 0 ~ 8, #"Non-Latino White"
    
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  ))

table(filtered_data$RaceEthnicity_final, useNA = "ifany")

# 1 = Latino
# 2 = Non-Latino African American
# 3 = Non-Latino Asian
# 4 = Non-Latino Multiracial
# 5 = Non-Latino Native American
# 6 = Non-Latino Other
# 7 = Non-Latino Pacific Islander
# 8 = Non-Latino White

```



#Creating a categorical APS2 variable in CABBS

```{r}
library(dplyr)

filtered_data <- filtered_data %>%
  mutate(APS2_cat = case_when(
    APS2 < 47.5 ~ "Negative",
    APS2 > 47.5  ~ "Positive",
    TRUE  ~ NA_character_
  ))

table(filtered_data$APS2_cat) #looking in entire data
table(filtered_data$APS2_cat[filtered_data$BD_Status_collected == 1]) #looking only among those who blood draw status was collected
```

```{r codebook function}
codebook <- function(data, var, categorical = TRUE, print.values = TRUE) {
  #testing out specific variables below 
 #data <- cabbs_data
 #var <- "YearsEducationUS"
 #categorical = F 
 #print.values = TRUE
 
  print(str_c(var))
  
  if(categorical) {
    # print the frequency table
    # with absolute, relative and cumulative frequencies
    print(str_c("Frequency table of ", var))
    tab1(data[var], graph = FALSE, cum.percent = TRUE) %>% print()
  } else {
    x <- data[var] %>% as_vector()
    na_count <- sum(is.na(x))
    total_count <- sum(!is.na(x))
    mean_cont <- round(mean(x,na.rm = TRUE), digits = 2)
    sd_cont <- round(sd(x, na.rm = TRUE), digits = 2)
    quant_cont <- quantile(x, probs = c(0.0, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
    na_perc <- round(na_count/length(x), digits = 2)
    total_perc <- round(total_count/length(x), digits = 2)
    print(str_c("Frequency: ", total_count, " (", 100*total_perc, "%)"))
    print(str_c("NA Frequency: ", na_count, " (", 100*na_perc, "%)"))
    print(str_c("mean (sd): ", mean_cont, " (", sd_cont, ")" ))
    print(quant_cont)
    try(hist(x, main = NULL, xlab = paste(var)))
  }
  
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

#Cleaning continuous variables -\> setting values as missing

```{r}
#Creating a clean version of continuous variables with missing set to a value
filtered_data$ImmigrationYear_clean <- filtered_data$ImmigrationYear  
filtered_data$ImmigrationYear_clean[filtered_data$ImmigrationYear_clean %in% c(-1, -2, 4)] <- NA

filtered_data$YearsEducationUS_clean <- filtered_data$YearsEducationUS  
filtered_data$YearsEducationUS_clean[filtered_data$YearsEducationUS_clean %in% c(99)] <- NA

filtered_data$Time_Since_Referral_yrs <- filtered_data$Time_Since_Referral/-365.25

```
